title: R8 · Module 1 — Source to bytecode
description: Module 1 of the R8 curriculum. Follows ultra's TapApp.kt through the Kotlin compiler into TapApp.class: the file layout, the constant pool (every name stored as text), the stack-machine instructions of onCreate, linking by name at runtime, and the metadata attributes. Ends on the two facts R8 is built around: renaming must be done everywhere at once, and lookups by string are invisible.
